title: Commanders put Laremy Tunsil, Johnny Newton on IR; re-sign Fabian Moreau and Shy Tuttle

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Commanders put Laremy Tunsil, Johnny Newton on IR; re-sign Fabian Moreau and Shy Tuttle
sources.description: The Commanders are leaving the door open for left tackle Laremy Tunsil and defensive tackle Johnny Newton to return to action at some point during the 2026 season.
